headline: Did you think Snoop Dogg was guilty or innocent when he went to trial in 1995 for murder?
body: Did you think Snoop Dogg was guilty or innocent when he went to trial in 1995 for murder? The rapper was arrested in 1993 for his alleged role in the murder of Philip Woldemariam, a member of a rival gang, who was shot and killed by Snoop Dogg's bodyguard, McKinley Lee. Hit link in bio to watch a new episode of Take It to Trial. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
